newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in mid-June.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves up in mid-June.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $20.93 million in the first half of June to $6,496 million, according to central bank figures published on Tuesday.
Gross reserves had risen $62.15 million in the second half of May to $6,475 million.
Gross reserves include commercial banks' net foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.

The statement did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources said they exceeded $4,800 million in mid-June. They stood at $4,015 at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier.
